monument_name: Kani Bāhāḥ at Oku Bāhāḥ (1702 CE)
description_en: Kani Bāhāḥ is a branch of Oku Bāhāḥ (Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra,LAL2260) and was established in 1702 (NS 822) by Devarāja Śākya. It is located at the southeast corner of Lalitpur city, on the way to Sincāhiti from Oku Bāhāḥ. This Bāhāḥ is on the fringe of the city, at the crossroad of the roads from Prayag Pokhari to Gwarko and Satdobato. It can be accessed via a carved door on the northern side of the complex. The front facade of the main door has changed and shops have been built up around it. Two doors have also been added on either side of it.The main door is accentuated by two small blind windows and carvings of deities on either side of it. Entering the door via a vestibule, one finds a colonnaded space (phalcā) on the second bay, as well as images of Gaṇeśa, Mahākāla and Hanumān to the left, on the eastern wall, and an image of Bhīmasena to the right, on the western wall. The Phalcā has three bays and a pair of columns (jvaḥthā̃). The main courtyard is surrounded by a plinth, measures 8.85m x 8.85m, and is 45cm below the level of the Phalcā.The main sanctum building is a three-storey structure built on the southern wing of the courtyard. It has a richly carved central main door on the ground floor that is flanked by two small windows with circular lattice work on either side. The upper floor is distinguished by a band of carved timber cornice that is typical to Newar architecture. On the first floor, one can find apasukājhyāhwith two aedicules on either side. The second floor is mainly occupied by a central slanting projected window known asgā jhyāḥ. The sanctum building has two exit doors on the ground floor; the eastern door leads to an open space to the south, while the western one is the entrance to a residential building. There are two lattice windows on the first floor and one single window on the second floor. The roof is covered withjhiṅgatitiles and has astūpafinial on its ridge. The building now stands in the shadow of a newly constructed five-storey building behind it, i.e. to its south.The courtyard is well paved with high qualityteliyātiles. It contains a Durgatipariśodhanacaitya(220cm high), a statue of some donors and adharmadhātu maṇḍala(80cm high). These are all lined up in front of the main sanctum building.The north-facing god house of the Bāhāḥ has three storeys, though it was seriously affected by the 2015 earthquake. It can be found at the southern side of the courtyard. Its worn tiled-roof is damaged in some parts, and vegetation is growing on and through it. Although the roof is dilapidated, it is still topped by acaitya-shaped pinnacle.According to Bāhāḥ members, Lalitpur Metropolitan City provided 28 Lakh Rupees for the reconstruction of the monastery.
description_ne: ओकुबाहा: (रुद्रवर्ण महाविहार), लुँखुसि, सिन्चा र प्रयागपोखरी जाने चौबाटोनिर ओकुबाहा:को दक्षिणपट्टि यो कनि बाहा  रहेको छ । यो विहार ओकुबाहा:को शाखा हो । सुन बगाएर ल्याउने लुँखुसि नदीसँगै रहेकोले यस विहारको नाम कनकवर्ण विहार रहेको हो भन्ने लोकोक्ति सुनिन्छ । यो विहार १७०२ (नेसं ८२२) मा देवराज शाक्यले स्थापना गरेका थिए । यस विहारभित्र पस्न निजी घरको बाटो भएर जानुपर्छ । मूल ढोकाबाट छिरेपछि अर्को एउटा ढोका राखिएको छ, त्यो ढोका पार गरेपछि विहारभित्र पुगिन्छ । दोस्रो ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ फल्चा बनाइएका छन् । ढोकाको पूर्वमा गणेश, महाकाल र हनुमान्‌को मूर्ति राखिएका छन् भने पश्चिममा भीमसेनको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । ढोकाको सामुन्ने पहिले नै जीर्ण भइसकेको र सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले झनै जीर्ण बनेको उत्तराभिमुख तीनतल्ले द्य:छेँ उभिएको देखिन्छ । द्य:छेँको शिरमा झिँगटीको छानामाथि गजूरको रूपमा सानो चैत्य राखिएको छ । छानामा घाँस उम्रेर पानी चुहिने अवस्था भैसकेको छ । द्य:छेँको दोस्रो तलामा कलात्मक गा:झ्या: (balconied window) छ भने विहारको आगम रहेको पहिलो तलामा पासुखा झ्या: (five-fold window) राखिएको छ । त्यसको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । द्य:छेँको भुइँतलामा विहारको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने कलात्मक ढोकामाथि तोरण भने छैन, अनि ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ सिंह पनि राखिएका छैनन् । ढोकाको दायाँ-बायाँ एक-एकवटा गोलझ्या: (circular window) छन् । गर्भगृहभित्र अक्षोभ्यको सुनको मोलम्बा लगाइएको तामाको उत्तराभिमुख मूर्ति छ । विसं २०४०-४१ सालतिर पुरानो मूर्ति चोरी भएपछि नयाँ बनाएर यो मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको हो । विहार परिसरमा एउटा दुर्गतिपरिशोधन चैत्य, भक्तजनको मूर्ति र धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएको छ ।विहारका सदस्यहरूले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार विहार जीर्ण भई कुनै पनि बेला भत्कन सक्ने अवस्थामा पुगेकोले पुनर्निर्माणका लागि ललितपुर महानगरपालिकाबाट २८ लाख रुपैयाँ निकासी भइसकेको छ र अब चाँडै नै विहार पुनर्निर्माणको काम शुरु हुँदैछ ।

historical_events.event_name: Consecration of the statue of the donors
historical_events.event_description: Statue of Kīrtirāja and his two wives was established.
Thisvihārawas constructed by Devarāja Śākya at the same time as the images of Gaṇeśa, Mahākākla and Hanumān. The images of theāgama devatāandkvāḥpāḥdyaḥwere also consecrated at the same time.

historical_events.event_name: Construction of the tower over the roof
historical_events.event_description: Devarāja Śākya and his wife Manoharā constructed the cover over the roof and raised a metal flag.
A Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala was consecrated at thevihāra-courtyard by Harṣaratna, Devarāja, Dhanavīra and other family members
